extraction.Name: Mollie Gaughen Smith
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I just took it when it was handed me in an envelope, supposing that we had to take the patents when they were issued.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I should like to have some body responsible for the issuance of the patent pay back the taxes amounting to $190 that I paid on this land before I sold it.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at a bank in Dallas in 1918. Mortgaged for $1000, then sold for $7500 paid in three installments. Paid $190 in taxes on land before sale. States she would just as soon the patent had not been issued; would like the patent back if possible. Has five children. Notary: Jas. W. Gross, commission expires 4-28-52. Subscribed and sworn April 26, 1929.
